Game Overview

Penguin Dash is a casual title where guide your adorable penguin across an ever-changing world of disappearing boxes. Tap left or right to dodge obstacles and stay on course. Test your reflexes and aim for record-breaking distances in this fast-paced, challenging adventure. How far can you dash before the ground vanishes beneath you?

How to Play

Playing Penguin Dash comes down to a simple loop. Guide your adorable penguin across an ever-changing world of disappearing boxes. Tap left or right to dodge obstacles and stay on course. Test your reflexes and aim for record-breaking distances in this fast-paced, challenging adventure. How far can you dash before the ground vanishes beneath you?
